messages:
ajay: Heads-up — premerge scan results lost commit metadata after the keystore rotation last night. Several findings now show 'owner: unknown' which is blocking approvals. Seen on ~30 PRs. Anyone on triage?

sophie: saw a couple, assumed scanner flake. Filed a quick ticket: GH-5423. :eyes:

maya: do you have a log snippet or payload? need to see if commit_id is missing or just not parsed.

ajay: here's a minimal webhook payload we captured: 
```json
POST /scan/callback 200
{
  "pr": 3221,
  "findings": [ { "rule": "SST-001", "path": "src/auth/login.go" } ],
  "metadata": {
    "commit_id": null,
    "author": "alice"
  },
  "headers": {
    "X-Keystore-Version": ""
  }
}
```
I can forward the full webhook payloads if helpful.

julian: that header should have been set by keystore-agent. @maria — any rotations at ~03:12 UTC?

maria: yes, rotated keystore v3 -> v4 at 2026-03-21T03:12:05Z. Audit log id: audit_20260321_0312_abc123. Agent restarted around the same time, no crash recorded.

maya: sounds like agent restarted before it re-attached the signer env, so it emitted an empty header. Short-term fixes: make scanner tolerant of missing header, and add a tag to findings created in the window. Long-term: patch agent to emit stable keystore-version earlier on startup.

ajay: short-term action: can we re-run webhook processing for affected PRs so metadata populates? I can requeue payloads if we can reconstruct the header from audit logs.

julian: I'll push a small patch to keystore-agent to re-add header on startup and add defensive parsing in the scanner. Plan: canary -> full. I can also add a one-off reindex job to replay payloads.

maria: I can export audit entries (request_id -> keystore_version) for 03:08-03:20 UTC. Use audit_20260321_0312_*. That should let you reconstruct the header for most requests.

sophie: for triage noise, suggest tagging findings with `sdlc:keystore-rotation` for the 03:10-03:20 UTC window and exempting those tags from automated premerge blocking rules. That reduces urgent noise while we reprocess.

maya: also a compliance note — preserve original webhook payloads as evidence. Don't delete them while we reconcile. I'll open COMP ticket.

oncall: pinged — if this is causing merge blocks we can temporarily allow premerge approvals to bypass owner checks for PRs in that window, but need manager/engineering lead signoff. Who will own the unblock?

ajay: I'll own the immediate unblock + coordinate approvals. @julian can you estimate patch+reindex time?

julian: patch + canary ~30m, full deploy ~45m after canary, reindex for ~30 PRs ~20m. Let's budget 2 hours. Starting patch now. :thumbsup: 

sec-bot: deploy keystore-agent v4.0.1 started by julian (deploy-789).

ajay: thanks. I'll queue the reprocessing once keystore-agent emits a stable header. @sophie @maya please hold triage on PRs with the temporary tag.

sophie: holding. will annotate open findings and ping authors to avoid duplicate triage.

maya: opened compliance ticket COMP-211 with audit id and retention note.

ajay: I'll follow up in #incidents if anything goes sideways. Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick sync.
